desc:
🏀 Challenge players or CPUs to half court basketball. First to the target score wins!

🎯 Time every release to hit a green
🔥 Break ankles with crossovers, step backs and spins
⭐ Unlock styles and abilities to build your player
👥 Team up with friends in 2v2 and larger games

Thanks for supporting the game! 🧡

PC Controls:
Shoot / Pump Fake - Space
Crossover - J
Step Back - K
Drive - L
Spin - L, then J
Pass (Team Games) - I
Ability - Q
Steal (Defense) - J
Block (Defense) - K
Slide (Defense) - L

Console Controls:
Shoot / Pump Fake - X
Crossover - B
Step Back - Y
Drive - RT
Spin - RB
Pass (Team Games) - A
Ability - D-Pad Left
Steal (Defense) - X
Block (Defense) - Y
Slide (Defense) - LT
